{{Quote|You put on quite a show&mdash;well at least until you catapulted Dame Malitikis into the dessert cart. But the surgeon says her shoulder will be good as new.|[[Pelf Pachoola]], to Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
[[Dame/Legends|Dame]] '''Malitikis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who accompanied the [[Salin Excursions]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' on a cruise at some point during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the voyage, the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]&mdash;who was disguised as a businessman and operating under the alias "Rondo Rosada&mdash;" became inebriated and danced with Malitikis. However, Ohnaka's flamboyant style of dancing resulted in Malitikis being hurled into a dessert cart, inflicting damage onto her shoulder. Her injury was subsequently attended to by surgeon, and by the following morning Malitikis had been given assurances that her shoulder was healed.
